PROVEN THIS TURN: docs/venice-audit-v1/build_matrices.py@99818667 (142 lines) writes OUT_CSV=DATA_REQUIREMENTS.csv (19 COLS starting inventory_id) and OUT_MAN=SOURCE_MANIFEST.json, reads dictionary/WORLD_SNAPSHOT_DICTIONARY.csv, dictionary/DATA_SOURCES.csv, docs/LENSES_COVERAGE_V1.csv, docs/WORLD_COVERAGE.csv; __main__ runs main() then run_extras() -> build_extra.main() + build_gantt.main().
